model.title: A resolution designating September 2026 as "National Childhood Cancer Awareness Month".

summary.text: The resolution would designate September 2026 as "National Childhood Cancer Awareness Month" to raise awareness about childhood cancer and highlight the importance of supporting children battling the disease and their families.
